title: finding(app-shell): Studio's Interfaces pillar hands its page inspectors a hard-coded readOnly={false} on a read-only package, while its autosave discards the edit
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` a named producer: objectstack's `examples/app-showcase` package `com.example.showcase`. It is source-loaded and read-only: `GET /api/v1/packages` answers `writable: false`, as measured by objectstack-ai/objectstack#20674 for objectui#11124. It authors 22 pages under `src/ui/pages/`, which the Interfaces pillar opens.

The discarded edit on this pillar is read at source, not driven. Its twin on the Automations pillar was measured by that same acceptance run (F-5: an inspector edit takes on the canvas, no write leaves the browser, and the edit is gone on reopen).

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11135 (objectui#11124). It comes from the dev report's out-of-scope note. That PR's contract review (`5897252751`, ③) confirmed it real at the head and asked for a carrier. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites (read at objectui `origin/main` `db11afd49`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)

- `InterfacesPillar` (`:1536`) creates the surface `Inspector` with `readOnly={false}` at `:2318` and the `DefaultInspector` with `readOnly={false}` at `:2372`.
- Both of its autosaves carry `readOnly` in `blocked:` (`:1999`, `:2038`). On a read-only package, an inspector edit therefore takes locally, nothing announces that it will not persist, and nothing is saved.
- The Data pillar threads the real flag (objectui#2259). PR objectui#11135 now does the same for the Automations pillar.

## Question for triage

`InterfacesPillar`'s `readOnly` prop is documented as "hide/disable nav-authoring affordances" (`:1556`), which is narrower than the Data and Automations wording. The review's reading is that it is the same defect class: a Studio pillar's inspector ignores the pillar's `readOnly` while its autosave discards the edit. The fix shape is the one objectui#2259 and PR objectui#11135 used, which is to thread the pillar's real flag with no second mechanism. The question for triage is whether the page inspectors fall inside that contract.

## Dedupe

The 1162 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231; the 300 newest fetched now), were grepped:
- `InterfacesPillar`: 4 hits (PRs objectui#11041, #10775, #10697, #10687), none about read-only.
- `Interfaces pillar`: 3 hits (PR objectui#11135, the source, plus PRs objectui#10906 and #10775).
- `readOnly={false}`: 2 hits (PR objectui#11135 and PR objectui#11090).
- `surface inspector … read-only`: 0 hits.

No card covers these sites.
